milestones.name: Baseline Freeze and Program Integration
milestones.outcome: The current M2.3-r1 baseline, roadmap authority, evidence model, and review packet format are frozen before further code changes.

milestones.name: M2.3-r2 — Exact Numeric Runtime IR and Compiled Router Closure
milestones.outcome: Current-pack execution is fully numeric, fail-before-ready, route plans are exact, schema identities are operational, and the router resolves directly to a numeric RoutePlan.

milestones.name: M2.4 — Zero-Copy Ingress and Worker-Local Request Bridge
milestones.outcome: Requests route before decoding, unread fields are never materialized, and request state is owned by the QuickJS worker without a process-wide request-store mutex.

milestones.name: M2.5 — Schema-Specialized Input and JSON Output Pipeline
milestones.outcome: The compiler selects measured, schema-aware decoders and encoders while maintaining exact Treaty/OpenAPI/runtime semantics.

milestones.name: M2.6 — Binary QPack v2 and Reproducible Artifact ABI
milestones.outcome: Production startup maps a deterministic binary pack with raw bytecode, precompiled router/runtime IR, strict ABI fingerprinting, and no JSON/base64 reconstruction.

milestones.name: M2.7 — Capability Linker and Minimal Web Runtime
milestones.outcome: Only declared native capabilities are linked, lifecycle and cancellation are standardized, and a small WinterTC-aligned Web API subset is conformant.

milestones.name: M2.8 — Native Outbound Fetch
milestones.outcome: Velqu provides bounded, cancellable, pooled Web fetch with TLS/DNS correctness, streaming backpressure, and explicit SSRF policy.

milestones.name: M3 — Multi-Worker Service Runtime
milestones.outcome: Independent QuickJS workers scale across cores with bounded queues, quarantine/replacement, and distinct serverless/service/throughput profiles.

milestones.name: M4 — Developer Experience and Private Alpha
milestones.outcome: The actual Rust/QuickJS runtime is pleasant to develop against, Treaty modes are complete, Linux release artifacts exist, and a realistic proof service is private-alpha ready.

milestones.name: M5 — Production Operations and Real-World Proof
milestones.outcome: Operational controls, observability, optional Postgres integration, executable cross-framework workloads, and a controlled production canary establish technical production candidacy.

milestones.name: M6 — Security, Reliability, Platform, and Supply-Chain Hardening
milestones.outcome: The runtime passes fuzzing, sanitizers, chaos, soak, supported-platform, vulnerability, reproducibility, and artifact-integrity gates.

milestones.name: M7 — API/ABI Stabilization and Release Candidate
milestones.outcome: Public APIs, QPack/runtime/capability ABIs, SemVer behavior, migration rules, publishing automation, and RC canaries are stable.

milestones.name: M8 — Production-Ready GA Gate
milestones.outcome: All technical and owner gates are closed, signed reproducible artifacts are released, operations and rollback are documented, and the production-readiness review is approved.

tasks.title: Freeze the reviewed source baseline
tasks.objective: Bind all future work to the exact reviewed archive and a real Git commit.
deliverables: baseline git bundle or patch series
acceptance: SOURCE-BASELINE.md records archive name, SHA-256, source commit, toolchain locks, and known M2.3-r1 gaps.
A git bundle or repository commit is available; later review never relies only on an unversioned ZIP.

tasks.title: Adopt ADR-0019 production-readiness program
tasks.objective: Extend ADR-0018 through technical production candidate, RC, and GA without changing the minimal-core thesis.
acceptance: ADR-0019 is accepted and indexed.
The roadmap explicitly separates technical production readiness from public GA owner decisions.
Non-goals remain Node compatibility, hostile-code sandboxing, ORM-in-core, and unauthorized WebSocket/SSE work.

tasks.title: Install the production master agent prompt
tasks.objective: Give one coding agent authority to execute the full ordered program while preserving stop conditions and owner boundaries.
acceptance: AGENTS.md points to the new master prompt.
The former M2/M4 stop language is superseded unambiguously.
The agent may continue milestone-to-milestone only after local gates pass.

tasks.title: Create machine-readable task and evidence ledgers
tasks.objective: Make status, dependencies, claims, tests, reports, and artifacts auditable by tools and the final reviewer.
acceptance: TASKS.json validates against its schema.
Every task has acceptance and evidence fields.
Every completed claim links to source/test/raw evidence rather than prose alone.

tasks.title: Strengthen source-to-evidence verification
tasks.objective: Prevent reports from claiming code, tests, or benchmark results absent from the packaged source.
acceptance: verify fails stale generated reports, absent named tests, duplicate current-verification sections, and mismatched artifact hashes.
Benchmark summaries are generated from raw data.
Test counts come from captured runner output, not manual arithmetic.

tasks.title: Pass baseline program gate
tasks.objective: Authorize implementation only after the baseline, roadmap, prompt, evidence ledger, and review conventions are coherent.
acceptance: BASE-001 through BASE-005 are PASS.
Working tree is clean.
A checkpoint commit and review packet exist.

tasks.title: Define explicit numeric and legacy engine load plans
tasks.objective: Separate current numeric packs from legacy string-table compatibility so no current request pays dual-path cost.
acceptance: Numeric mode takes FunctionDecl[] as the only vector contract.
Numeric mode requires __velquFunctions and rejects absent/mismatched vectors before bind.
Legacy mode is version-gated and cannot be selected accidentally.

tasks.title: Enforce exact function-vector and manifest equivalence
tasks.objective: Make dense numeric dispatch fail closed for wrong in-range IDs, holes, kinds, duplicates, and length mismatches.
acceptance: Function IDs are dense and pack-local.
Each vector index is callable and matches exact key/kind.
No loader compaction or silent fallback occurs.

evidence_refs.reviewFinding: M2.3-r3 external review; gate-closure items addressed in M23R2-GATE-CLOSE revision

tasks.title: Enforce exact RoutePlan equivalence
tasks.objective: Cross-check the execution plan against route contracts before readiness.
acceptance: Declared response status set equals allowedStatuses exactly.
defaultStatus, deadline, response strategy, policy handler, field needs, and schema bindings match the canonical route.
Invalid HTTP status values and duplicates are rejected.

tasks.title: Operationalize RouteId, PolicyId, and SchemaId
tasks.objective: Move all current-pack route, policy, and schema identity to deterministic dense numeric indexes while retaining debug names.
acceptance: Compiler assigns stable deterministic IDs.
All schema references are non-null when a schema exists.
Debug-name tables preserve human-readable diagnostics without entering the hot path.

acceptance: FieldNeeds is a compact bitset or equivalent fixed representation.
Compiler derivation matches route params/query/headers/body/cookies/raw-request requirements.
Plan tampering or disagreement fails before ready.

tasks.title: Bind the numeric execution graph to pack integrity
tasks.objective: Detect corruption of function manifests, route plans, and policy-to-handler mappings.
acceptance: executionGraphSha256 or equivalent covers all execution-critical numeric metadata.
Public contract hash remains stable when only internal numeric layout changes.
Tamper fixtures fail before bind.

tasks.title: Implement numeric terminal router automaton
tasks.objective: Replace startup-built candidate scanning with one compiled traversal to a method terminal and RoutePlan.
acceptance: Router returns RouteId/RoutePlan directly.
405 Allow comes from a terminal method mask without repeated matching.
Collision and shadow detection occur at compile time.
No Router::build semantic reconstruction is required for current packs.

tasks.title: Remove current-pack string dispatch and duplicate references
tasks.objective: Eliminate __velquRegister, handler BTreeMap, per-request handler/policy strings, and duplicate persistent handles for current packs.
acceptance: numeric_dispatches > 0 and legacy_map_dispatches == 0 for proof app.
No registration calls in current generated bundles.
Legacy support lives only in explicit pack-version compatibility code.

tasks.title: Finish terminal settlement retention hardening
tasks.objective: Ensure every timeout, cancel, quarantine, and interrupted watch removes settlement entries and floating operations exactly once.
acceptance: Settlement table remains zero after repeated terminal cycles.
Timeout metric increments once.
Queue-empty-or-quarantined invariant holds at every worker message boundary.

tasks.title: Pass M2.3-r2 closure gate
tasks.objective: Close exact numeric artifact loading, router scope, evidence, and performance before M2.4 consumes RoutePlan.
acceptance: M23R2-001 through M23R2-009 are PASS.
Warm c=1/10/50 and 25/1,000-route cold evidence is regenerated with raw files and hashes.
No current-pack string lookup or runtime route reconstruction remains.
Treaty/OpenAPI/runtime behavior is unchanged.

tasks.title: Freeze ingress ownership and backpressure design
tasks.objective: Define how Hyper request parts and bodies move from HTTP tasks to one owning QuickJS worker without unbounded buffering.
acceptance: Ownership, cancellation, body-stream, and queue invariants are documented in an ADR.
No JS value or request slot crosses worker ownership ambiguously.

tasks.title: Route before request materialization
tasks.objective: Match method/path using borrowed HTTP types before query, headers, cookies, or body are decoded.
acceptance: C0/C1 routes do not parse query or clone headers.
Routes without bodies do not collect bodies.
Admission limits still apply before unsafe buffering.

tasks.title: Introduce worker-local generation-checked request slab
tasks.objective: Remove the process-wide RequestStore mutex and make the QuickJS worker the sole owner of live request state.
acceptance: Request slot allocation/access/settlement is lock-free inside the worker.
Generation and owner checks reject stale or foreign handles.
All slots are zero after quiescence.

tasks.title: Capture path parameters as byte ranges
tasks.objective: Avoid per-request parameter strings until validation or JS access requires them.
acceptance: Router captures offsets into the original path.
Native validators consume slices directly.
JS strings are created only for requested values.

tasks.title: Implement declared-header lazy access
tasks.objective: Read only headers named by policies or route schemas and materialize full Headers only through explicit fallback.
acceptance: No full header map clone on routes with no/limited header needs.
Case-insensitive semantics and duplicate-header behavior are specified and tested.
Raw enumeration is explicitly labeled as generic fallback.

tasks.title: Implement lazy query and cookie decoding
tasks.objective: Decode declared keys on demand while retaining raw fallback semantics.
acceptance: No query parser runs when FieldNeeds excludes query.
Duplicate keys, percent encoding, empty values, and invalid encoding have frozen semantics.
Cookie parsing is bounded and opt-in.

tasks.title: Implement bounded read-once body admission
tasks.objective: Support bytes/text/JSON body access with limits, cancellation, backpressure, and deterministic second-read behavior.
acceptance: Oversize bodies fail without unbounded allocation.
Request disconnect and route cancellation stop body reads.
Bytes remain Bytes where possible rather than Vec copies.

tasks.title: Replace per-request JS closure construction with native-backed prototypes
tasks.objective: Use one stable QuickJS object shape and opaque request handle instead of multiple getter closures per invocation.
acceptance: Context/request prototypes are cached once.
Native access validates phase, owner, slot, and generation.
Retained wrappers throw stable RequestExpiredError.

tasks.title: Add ingress and bridge observability
tasks.objective: Expose route lookup, queue wait, field materialization, bytes copied, slot count, and body read timing without hot-path logging.
acceptance: Metrics are bounded and disableable.
velqu inspect shows FieldNeeds and expected materialization.
No string request ID is created in log-off mode.

tasks.title: Pass zero-copy ingress gate
tasks.objective: Prove lazy materialization, ownership safety, cancellation, and meaningful fixed-overhead reduction.
acceptance: M24-001 through M24-009 are PASS.
No global request-store mutex remains.
Unread fields have zero materialization counters.
C0 >= 90% of matched raw Rust; C1/C3 p95 do not regress; bridge safety suites pass.

tasks.title: Define canonical Schema IR v2 and compatibility rules
tasks.objective: Make one normalized schema graph drive validators, codecs, Treaty, OpenAPI, and contract diff.
acceptance: Schema IDs and canonical encoding are deterministic.
Supported/unsupported transforms are explicit.
IR versioning and migrations are documented.

tasks.title: Build reproducible decoder/encoder strategy benchmark
tasks.objective: Compare QuickJS parse/stringify, generic Rust conversion, and generated schema-specialized codecs across realistic shapes.
acceptance: Payload matrix includes scalar, nested, arrays 100/1000, 1/16/64/128 KB, invalid and schema-invalid inputs.
Raw latency, allocation, bytes copied, heap, and correctness are retained.

tasks.title: Generate params/query/header decoders
tasks.objective: Fuse extraction, coercion, validation, and error-path reporting for scalar request fields.
acceptance: No generic object tree is created when route schemas are supported.
Validation errors preserve safe paths and stable codes.
Coercion remains source-specific and explicit.

tasks.title: Generate JSON body decoders
tasks.objective: Parse, validate, and materialize supported bodies in one measured route-specific path.
acceptance: Correct Unicode, number edge cases, required/optional/null, arrays, nesting, and unknown-property policy.
Body limits and cancellation remain enforced.
Fallback is visible in build report.

tasks.title: Generate status-specific response encoders
tasks.objective: Fuse response validation and serialization for declared shapes while preserving typed status semantics.
acceptance: No duplicate full-object validation plus serialization traversal.
Every declared status uses the correct schema.
Undeclared status or incompatible shape fails deterministically.

tasks.title: Generate RFC 9457 problem encoders
tasks.objective: Preserve standard fields and custom typed problem fields without leaking secrets.
acceptance: Problem schema/type/OpenAPI/Treaty outputs agree.
Getter/toJSON behavior remains deadline-bounded.
Redaction tests cover nested causes and source maps.

tasks.title: Implement explicit generic and Web fallback paths
tasks.objective: Keep raw Request/Response and unsupported schema semantics available without hiding their cost.
acceptance: Every fallback appears in build report and velqu inspect.
Fallback routes remain bounded and conformance-tested.
Core optimized routes do not import fallback modules.

tasks.title: Unify OpenAPI, Treaty, lock, and runtime schema projection
tasks.objective: Prevent drift between runtime codecs and developer-facing contracts.
acceptance: One canonical Schema IR projection feeds all artifacts.
Semantic diff detects nested object/array/union/enum/constraint changes.
Published client has no runtime implementation dependency.

tasks.title: Add codec fuzzing and differential tests
tasks.objective: Compare generated codecs with a trusted reference and exercise malformed inputs/outputs.
acceptance: No panic, UB, unbounded allocation, or divergent accepted value in supported IR subset.
Fuzz corpora and seeds are retained.
Failures become regression tests.

tasks.title: Pass schema-specialized pipeline gate
tasks.objective: Select route-level codecs from evidence and close semantic parity.
acceptance: M25-001 through M25-009 are PASS.
C2 reaches the approved engineering threshold or limitations are explicitly accepted.
Codec choice is inspectable per route.
No contract drift exists across runtime/Treaty/OpenAPI/lock.

tasks.title: Accept QPack v2 binary format ADR
tasks.objective: Freeze a sectioned, bounds-checkable, versioned production artifact that matches the compiled runtime IR.
acceptance: Header, section directory, alignment, endianness, size limits, and forward-compatibility rules are specified.
Development JSON remains inspection-only.

tasks.title: Define strict runtime and bytecode fingerprint
tasks.objective: Reject incompatible engine/build/ABI/target artifacts before evaluating code.
acceptance: Fingerprint includes QPack format, host ABI, engine/build hash, binding, bytecode format, target, pointer width, endianness, and capability hash.
Mismatch tests fail before bind.

tasks.title: Encode compiled router, RoutePlans, schemas, and functions as binary sections
tasks.objective: Persist the exact M2.3/M2.5 runtime graph without rebuilding it at startup.
acceptance: No runtime route collision work or status-string parsing.
All indexes and section references are bounds-checked.
Debug names are optional cold data.

tasks.title: Embed raw QuickJS bytecode without base64
tasks.objective: Remove base64 decode and duplicate production source from the hot startup path.
acceptance: Raw bytecode is one section and is hashed.
Source fallback is explicit and off by default for release.
No untrusted external bytecode is accepted.

tasks.title: Implement zero-copy or bounded-copy pack reader
tasks.objective: Map or read binary sections without reconstructing large owned object graphs.
acceptance: Every offset/length is validated before access.
Peak startup allocations are measured.
Malformed packs never panic or read out of bounds.

tasks.title: Add execution integrity and optional authenticity hooks
tasks.objective: Separate corruption detection from publisher authenticity.
acceptance: Canonical section digests cover all executable metadata.
Optional Ed25519 or equivalent signature verification is pluggable.
Docs clearly distinguish digest vs signature.

tasks.title: Guarantee reproducible release packs
tasks.objective: Produce identical pack bytes for identical normalized inputs.
acceptance: Two clean builds produce identical hashes.
Timestamps and host paths do not contaminate output.
Build report records all non-reproducible inputs.

tasks.title: Provide explicit v1 compatibility and migration tool
tasks.objective: Avoid accidental dual paths inside the current runtime while supporting controlled migration.
acceptance: v1 loads only through versioned adapter or conversion command.
v2 runtime path allocates no v1 maps.
Unsupported legacy artifacts fail with actionable diagnostics.

tasks.title: Build shared-runtime and standalone deployment artifacts
tasks.objective: Support velqu-runtime + app.qpack and one-file embedded application modes from the same ABI.
acceptance: Both modes pass identical conformance.
Artifact hashes and sizes are recorded.
Graceful startup/shutdown semantics match.

tasks.title: Pass QPack v2 gate
tasks.objective: Prove startup reconstruction is gone and artifact trust/versioning is fail-closed.
acceptance: M26-001 through M26-009 are PASS.
25-route p50 <= approved small-app budget and 1,000-route p50/p95 meet approved scaling budget.
No JSON parse, base64 decode, string registration, or runtime Router::build in v2 release path.
Pack parser fuzz/security review passes.

tasks.title: Define capability ABI and lifecycle state machine
tasks.objective: Standardize install, dependency, lazy init, operation ownership, cancellation, shutdown, and version behavior.
acceptance: Capability identity/version/dependencies are explicit.
No capability can start native work outside an invocation/deferred owner.
Shutdown and quarantine semantics are defined.

tasks.title: Implement compile-time capability dependency resolver
tasks.objective: Link only required modules and reject cycles, conflicts, and missing versions before packaging.
acceptance: Dependency graph is deterministic.
Unused capabilities are absent from pack/binary.
Capability hash participates in runtime fingerprint.

tasks.title: Introduce custom QuickJS context profiles
tasks.objective: Measure minimal, Web, and compatibility contexts rather than always loading a full context.
acceptance: Profile choice is compiler-derived and inspectable.
No intrinsic removal without conformance and measurable benefit.
Missing APIs produce build diagnostics.

tasks.title: Implement console and timer core capabilities
tasks.objective: Move current natives behind the capability ABI and retain scheduler/cancellation invariants.
acceptance: Logging is structured/redacted and mode-controlled.
Timers are bounded, owned, physically cancellable, and shutdown-safe.

tasks.title: Implement URL and URLSearchParams
tasks.objective: Provide standards-aligned URL behavior required by backend code and fetch.
acceptance: Selected WPT/WinterTC cases pass.
Parsing limits and error behavior are documented.
Binary/startup/RSS cost is reported.

tasks.title: Implement text encoding APIs
tasks.objective: Provide TextEncoder/TextDecoder with explicit encoding support and bounds.
acceptance: UTF-8 correctness, invalid sequences, streaming options if supported, and large input limits are tested.
No hidden Node Buffer dependency.

tasks.title: Implement AbortController and AbortSignal
tasks.objective: Create one cancellation contract shared by timers, fetch, and future native operations.
acceptance: Abort reasons and event timing are deterministic.
Route deadlines compose with explicit signals.
Late completion and listener cleanup are leak-free.

tasks.title: Implement crypto random subset
tasks.objective: Provide getRandomValues and randomUUID from secure native entropy without broad crypto scope.
acceptance: Entropy source failures fail closed.
Input type/length rules are conformant.
No deterministic fallback exists in production.

tasks.title: Publish capability SDK and inspection surface
tasks.objective: Allow first-party/third-party capability packages without exposing engine internals.
acceptance: SDK example compiles and passes lifecycle/cancel tests.
velqu inspect shows dependencies, costs, and fallbacks.
ABI stability classification is documented.

tasks.title: Pass minimal Web runtime gate
tasks.objective: Prove modularity, lifecycle safety, standards behavior, and cold-start budget.
acceptance: M27-001 through M27-009 are PASS.
Core app pays for no unused capability.
Selected Test262/WPT/WinterTC matrix passes.
Startup/RSS deltas are within approved budgets.

tasks.title: Accept outbound fetch and SSRF security ADR
tasks.objective: Freeze public semantics, security defaults, proxy behavior, and non-goals before implementation.
acceptance: Web fetch is the public API; node:http/https are out of scope.
Default network policy and trust boundary are explicit.
Threat model covers DNS rebinding and redirects.

tasks.title: Select native client stack from evidence
tasks.objective: Compare reqwest versus Hyper-based composition for startup, binary size, pooling, cancellation, and streaming.
acceptance: Decision uses matched benchmark and conformance data.
Rejected alternative and tradeoffs are recorded.

tasks.title: Implement connection pooling, DNS, and TLS
tasks.objective: Provide bounded keep-alive pools, DNS cache policy, secure roots, hostname validation, and lazy initialization.
acceptance: No fetch capability cost when unused.
Pool limits/timeouts are configurable and bounded.
TLS verification cannot be disabled accidentally in production.

tasks.title: Implement Request/Response/Headers subset
tasks.objective: Expose the required Web-compatible fetch objects without forcing full Web wrappers on inbound routes.
acceptance: Header/body semantics and cloning rules are documented.
Unsupported properties fail clearly.
Large bodies remain streamed/bounded.

tasks.title: Propagate AbortSignal and route deadlines
tasks.objective: Cancel DNS/connect/TLS/write/read and response-body operations when the invocation terminates.
acceptance: Cancellation is physical and acknowledged.
No native task, connection, listener, or Promise remains after quiescence.
Timeout classification increments once.

tasks.title: Implement streaming and strict backpressure
tasks.objective: Bound request and response buffering across Rust/QuickJS boundaries.
acceptance: Slow consumers/producers do not create unbounded queues.
Reader cancellation releases sockets.
Streaming route metrics expose buffered bytes.

tasks.title: Implement redirect and compression policy
tasks.objective: Handle redirects, method/body rewriting, credential stripping, and content decoding consistently.
acceptance: Every redirect target is revalidated by SSRF policy.
Maximum redirects and decompressed-size limits are enforced.
Cross-origin sensitive headers are stripped per documented rules.

tasks.title: Implement SSRF and network egress controls
tasks.objective: Provide allow/deny policies for schemes, hosts, ports, private/link-local/loopback ranges, and DNS results.
acceptance: DNS rebinding and redirect bypass fixtures fail.
Policy can be configured per deployment/capability.
Diagnostics redact credentials.

tasks.title: Complete fetch conformance, observability, and shutdown
tasks.objective: Close Web behavior, pool metrics, graceful drain, source-mapped errors, and selected WPT cases.
acceptance: All connections/tasks close on shutdown.
Metrics show pool wait/connect/TLS/TTFB/body timings.
Selected WPT and upstream fixtures pass.

tasks.title: Pass native fetch gate
tasks.objective: Prove useful, secure, cancellable backend I/O without sacrificing the cold-start thesis.
acceptance: M28-001 through M28-009 are PASS.
Controlled upstream matrix 1/5/10/25 ms passes at c=1/10/50/200.
No unresolved SSRF/cancellation/backpressure P0/P1.
Capability remains absent from apps that do not use fetch.

tasks.title: Freeze independent-worker state semantics
tasks.objective: Document per-worker JS module state, shared native services, routing affinity, and no-JS-value-crossing rules.
acceptance: One QuickJS runtime is owned by one thread.
Application authors are warned that module state is per worker.
Shared service handles expose thread-safe Rust APIs only.

tasks.title: Implement bounded worker dispatcher
tasks.objective: Route compiled invocations to workers using bounded queues and measured load selection.
acceptance: Queue capacity and rejection behavior are deterministic.
Power-of-two or selected policy is benchmarked.
Queue wait is observable.

tasks.title: Implement runtime profiles
tasks.objective: Provide serverless, service, and throughput profiles with distinct startup and scaling behavior.
acceptance: Serverless starts exactly one worker.
Service starts ready with one and may add workers.
Throughput initializes configured workers before readiness.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic worker initialization and artifact sharing
tasks.objective: Load identical QPack/function/schema state per worker without mutable cross-worker JS state.
acceptance: Worker load failures prevent routing to that worker.
Read-only pack data is shared safely where possible.
Per-worker memory delta is measured.

tasks.title: Implement quarantine, replacement, and readiness aggregation
tasks.objective: Remove poisoned workers from service and replace them without continuing semantically broken JS execution.
acceptance: Poisoned worker receives no new work.
Pending requests fail closed or drain according to policy.
Replacement restores capacity; readiness reflects healthy worker count.

tasks.title: Implement adaptive scale-up and scale-down
tasks.objective: Adjust worker count from queue pressure and utilization without oscillation or cold-request surprise.
acceptance: Thresholds/hysteresis are documented.
Scale-down waits for quiescence.
Serverless profile never scales implicitly.

tasks.title: Implement multi-worker cancellation and graceful shutdown
tasks.objective: Stop admission, drain or cancel requests, close capabilities, and join workers within a bounded deadline.
acceptance: SIGTERM behavior is deterministic.
No task/slot/connection leak after shutdown.
Forced termination path is logged and bounded.

tasks.title: Add fairness and overload controls
tasks.objective: Prevent slow/CPU-heavy requests from starving unrelated work and define 429/503 load shedding.
acceptance: Per-worker queue, invocation, and native-op limits are enforced.
Overload errors are typed/observable.
Slow-request chaos does not deadlock all workers.

tasks.title: Run scaling, memory, and soak evidence
tasks.objective: Measure 1/2/4/8 workers with route, JSON, auth, controlled I/O, and mixed workloads.
acceptance: 2 workers >= approved scale factor; 4 workers >= approved scale factor.
Per-worker RSS is reported.
24-hour multi-worker soak has no monotonic leak or stuck queue.

tasks.title: Pass multi-worker service gate
tasks.objective: Demonstrate bounded scalable service mode while preserving single-worker serverless behavior.
acceptance: M3-001 through M3-009 are PASS.
Serverless cold-start budget is unchanged within tolerance.
Quarantine/replacement, overload, and shutdown gates pass.
No cross-worker JS ownership violation.

tasks.title: Implement actual-runtime velqu dev loop
tasks.objective: Use the real Rust/QuickJS runtime in development to prevent Bun-vs-production semantic drift.
acceptance: File changes compile incrementally, load a candidate worker, then atomically switch.
Failed reload leaves the last healthy app serving.
Source maps and diagnostics point to TypeScript source.

tasks.title: Complete CLI command surface
tasks.objective: Stabilize velqu dev/build/inspect/contract diff/test/package/doctor commands and exit codes.
acceptance: Commands have deterministic machine-readable output.
Invalid config fails before side effects.
CLI completion/help docs are generated.

tasks.title: Implement project scaffolding
tasks.objective: Create a minimal feature-based application with contracts, services, routes, Treaty tests, and deployment config.
acceptance: Generated project builds and runs offline after dependency install.
No demo secrets or unsafe production defaults.
Template passes current verify.

tasks.title: Complete Treaty unit-local, runtime-local, and remote modes
tasks.objective: Provide typed direct dispatch, real-runtime integration, and network use with identical contracts.
acceptance: No public any.
2xx/non-2xx/transport errors narrow correctly.
Unit-local is truly network-free and clearly labeled.

tasks.title: Publish compact contract and SDK artifacts
tasks.objective: Allow separate frontend repositories without importing server implementation.
acceptance: Generated package is tree-shakable and versioned.
Contract hash and mismatch diagnostics are available.
100/500/1,000-route TypeScript budgets pass.

tasks.title: Finalize diagnostics, source maps, and inspect output
tasks.objective: Make unsupported APIs, route plans, capabilities, fallbacks, performance strategies, and runtime failures actionable.
acceptance: Every diagnostic has stable code and source location.
Secrets remain redacted.
inspect output matches QPack/runtime graph exactly.

tasks.title: Implement bounded defer and lifecycle hooks
tasks.objective: Support explicit post-response work without pretending it is durable background processing.
acceptance: defer has owner, timeout, queue cap, cancellation, and observability.
Shutdown waits or cancels according to policy.
Docs direct durable work to external queues.

tasks.title: Build documentation and examples
tasks.objective: Provide installation, contracts, policies, Treaty, capabilities, deployment, limitations, and migration material.
acceptance: Docs are versioned and tested.
Examples cover small API, auth, fetch, streaming, and multi-worker service.
No unsupported Node compatibility implication.

tasks.title: Build realistic private-alpha proof service
tasks.objective: Exercise 30–50 routes, auth, pagination, typed errors, fetch, lifecycle, observability, and deployment.
acceptance: Reference app uses actual runtime, not special benchmark bypasses.
Operational runbook and load profile exist.
Known limitations are explicit.

tasks.title: Pass private-alpha gate
tasks.objective: Make Velqu usable by a small invited group without claiming public production readiness.
acceptance: M4-001 through M4-009 are PASS.
Linux x86_64 and arm64 artifacts pass smoke/conformance or owner-approved scope is recorded.
No unresolved P0; P1s have explicit alpha disposition.
Private-alpha docs and support channel exist.

tasks.title: Make the real-world benchmark harness executable
tasks.objective: Turn SPEC/workloads/schema into reproducible containers, datasets, load generator, result schema, and report generator.
acceptance: W1–W4 run from one command.
Dataset reset is deterministic.
CPU/RSS/pool wait/queue wait/p50/p95/p99/errors are captured.

tasks.title: Implement matched competitor candidates
tasks.objective: Provide Raw Rust, Elysia 2, Hono/Bun, and Fastify/Node candidates with equivalent semantics.
acceptance: Same SQL, schema, JWT, pool size, response bytes, logging, limits, and timeout behavior.
Fairness audit passes before performance interpretation.

tasks.title: Implement controlled upstream and CPU/JIT crossover suites
tasks.objective: Measure scheduler/I/O behavior separately from database-driver differences and identify cumulative cold-vs-hot crossover.
acceptance: Delay matrix 0/1/5/10/25/50 ms and payload 256B/1K/16K/64K.
CPU levels and first/10/100/1k/10k request phases are captured.
Break-even analysis uses measured startup and per-request cost.

tasks.title: Authorize and implement optional Postgres capability
tasks.objective: Provide one official database capability after M2.7 lifecycle rules, without adding database code to core.
acceptance: Pool is lazy, bounded, cancellable, and gracefully closed.
Parameterized query API prevents accidental string interpolation.
Capability absent from unrelated apps.

tasks.title: Implement auth/JWT reference capability or policy package
tasks.objective: Exercise real cryptographic verification and typed authorization without making auth a core product.
acceptance: Pinned algorithms and key handling are secure by default.
401/403 distinction is typed.
Key rotation and clock-skew behavior are documented.

tasks.title: Implement production configuration and secret handling
tasks.objective: Define files/env/CLI precedence, validation, secret redaction, immutable runtime config, and reload policy.
acceptance: Invalid config fails before bind.
Secrets never appear in logs/reports/crash output.
Config schema is documented and versioned.

tasks.title: Implement production observability
tasks.objective: Provide structured logs, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry-compatible metrics, traces, request IDs, worker/queue/pool health, and sampling controls.
acceptance: Observability can be disabled or sampled with measured overhead.
Trace context propagates through fetch and DB capability.
No full per-request JSON allocation when disabled.

tasks.title: Implement trusted-proxy, drain, and deployment semantics
tasks.objective: Make reverse-proxy headers, client IP, graceful SIGTERM, readiness, liveness, startup, and rolling deployment behavior explicit.
acceptance: Trusted proxy ranges are configured, never assumed.
Readiness goes false before drain.
Container exits within configured deadline with no accepted-work loss beyond policy.

tasks.title: Run real-world load, leak, and canary evidence
tasks.objective: Validate W1–W4, controlled I/O, CPU crossover, 1M+ requests, fault recovery, and one controlled production-like canary.
acceptance: Raw evidence and environment manifests retained.
No monotonic slot/task/pool/RSS leak.
Negative or losing results remain documented.

tasks.title: Pass technical production candidate gate
tasks.objective: Declare suitability for controlled production only after operations and real workloads pass.
acceptance: M5-001 through M5-009 are PASS.
No unresolved P0; production-affecting P1s have owner-approved disposition.
Runbook, observability, rollback, and on-call contact exist for canary users.
No public GA claim is made.

tasks.title: Update complete threat model and trust boundaries
tasks.objective: Cover compiler, QPack, bytecode, FFI, capabilities, fetch, DB, multi-worker, supply chain, and operator configuration.
acceptance: Assets/actors/entry points/abuse cases/controls are current.
Same-process trusted-code limitation is prominent.
Every high risk maps to a test/control.

tasks.title: Run sustained fuzz and property campaigns
tasks.objective: Fuzz HTTP admission, router, QPack, schema codecs, bridge handles, Treaty encoders, fetch parsers, and capability metadata.
acceptance: Configured campaign duration and corpus are recorded.
No crash, panic, UB, or unbounded allocation remains.
Findings become regression tests.

tasks.title: Run sanitizers, Miri, concurrency, and unsafe audits
tasks.objective: Exercise FFI and native lifetime invariants beyond normal tests.
acceptance: All unsafe blocks have documented invariants.
Applicable ASan/LSan/TSan/UBSan/Miri/Loom-style checks pass or have explicit platform waivers.
No known memory-safety P0/P1.

tasks.title: Establish dependency and license supply-chain policy
tasks.objective: Pin, audit, allowlist, and monitor Rust/Bun dependencies and transitive licenses.
acceptance: No unresolved critical/high exploitable advisory.
License policy matches owner decision.
Engine and binding upgrade lane is tested separately.

tasks.title: Generate SBOM and provenance
tasks.objective: Produce machine-readable components and build provenance for every release artifact.
acceptance: SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM and provenance reference exact source/toolchains.
Artifacts and metadata are hashed and later signed.
Rebuild process is documented.

tasks.title: Prove reproducible builds on independent builders
tasks.objective: Build the same source on two clean supported environments and compare normalized outputs.
acceptance: QPack and binaries reproduce or all allowed differences are explained.
Build images/toolchains are pinned.
Failure blocks RC.

tasks.title: Complete supported-platform matrix
tasks.objective: Run build/conformance/performance smoke on owner-approved GA platforms.
acceptance: At minimum Linux x86_64 and arm64 are decided and tested or narrowed by owner decision.
Unsupported platforms fail/document clearly.
Cross-compilation artifacts are exercised on real architecture.

tasks.title: Run chaos and fault-injection program
tasks.objective: Exercise worker poison, upstream/DB failure, DNS/TLS errors, queue saturation, OOM pressure, process signals, and corrupt artifacts.
acceptance: No deadlock or silent auth bypass.
Readiness/load shedding/rollback behave as documented.
Recovery time and lost-work policy are measured.

tasks.title: Run long soak and performance-regression qualification
tasks.objective: Prove stable memory/resources and pin benchmark budgets before RC.
acceptance: 24-hour minimum and selected 72-hour soak pass.
At least 10M representative requests or approved equivalent.
No monotonic RSS/task/slot/connection growth beyond defined tolerance.
Performance regressions block merge automatically.

tasks.title: Pass security and reliability hardening gate
tasks.objective: Reach independently reviewable technical production readiness.
acceptance: M6-001 through M6-009 are PASS.
Independent security review has no unresolved critical/high issue.
Supported platforms, reproducibility, SBOM, chaos, and soak gates pass.
Incident response draft exists.

tasks.title: Freeze public TypeScript API and Treaty semantics
tasks.objective: Define stable package exports, error/result shapes, route declarations, schema behavior, and deprecation rules.
acceptance: No public any or accidental internal types.
API extractor/baseline detects breaking changes.
SemVer classification fixtures pass.

tasks.title: Freeze runtime, QPack, and capability ABI policies
tasks.objective: Define compatibility windows, migration tooling, engine fingerprint behavior, and deprecation support.
acceptance: Old supported artifacts either load or fail with migration guidance.
No silent bytecode/ABI fallback.
Capability SDK has version negotiation rules.

tasks.title: Implement release and package publishing automation
tasks.objective: Build, test, sign, publish, and verify @velqu packages, Rust binaries, QPack tools, checksums, SBOM, and provenance.
acceptance: Dry-run and staging registry tests pass.
Published packages install in clean consumers.
Rollback/yank procedure is documented.

tasks.title: Complete versioned documentation and migration guides
tasks.objective: Publish API reference, operator guide, capability authoring, troubleshooting, security model, performance methodology, and upgrade paths.
acceptance: Docs match RC binaries/packages.
All code samples run in CI.
Known limitations and non-goals are prominent.

tasks.title: Resolve owner-controlled public release decisions
tasks.objective: Close repository/org, license, supported platform promise, governance, security contact, and release authority.
acceptance: OD-003 through OD-006 are DECIDED.
License headers/package metadata are updated.
Security policy and code of conduct/governance documents exist as chosen.

tasks.title: Run RC compatibility and canary program
tasks.objective: Exercise clean installs, upgrades, rollback, real reference apps, platform artifacts, and controlled production canaries.
acceptance: At least two independent consumer projects pass.
Upgrade from prior alpha/beta fixture succeeds or migration path is proven.
No unresolved RC P0/P1.

tasks.title: Freeze public benchmark and positioning statements
tasks.objective: Approve only fixture-specific claims supported by current raw evidence.
acceptance: Every claim names versions, environment, workload, artifacts, and p50/p95/p99.
Cold start distinguishes engine/process/container/scale-to-zero.
Negative and crossover results are disclosed.

tasks.title: Pass release-candidate gate
tasks.objective: Produce a signed, installable, documented, supportable RC with stable APIs and no open release blockers.
acceptance: M7-001 through M7-007 are PASS.
All owner decisions required for publication are closed.
RC artifacts install and roll back.
No unresolved P0/P1; P2 backlog is published.

tasks.title: Conduct formal production-readiness review
tasks.objective: Review architecture, security, reliability, operations, performance, compatibility, support, and rollback against the frozen gates.
acceptance: Every gate has source/test/raw-evidence references.
No unsupported claim or unexecuted required check is hidden.
Reviewer findings are classified P0/P1/P2 under the frozen scope.

tasks.title: Finalize operational SLOs, alerts, and runbooks
tasks.objective: Define supported service indicators and operator actions for startup, readiness, queues, workers, fetch, DB, errors, and resource use.
acceptance: SLOs have measurement sources and alert thresholds.
Runbooks cover common failure modes and rollback.
Canary dashboards are validated.

tasks.title: Finalize release signing, rollback, and disaster recovery
tasks.objective: Make every GA artifact verifiable and every release reversible.
acceptance: Artifacts/checksums/SBOM/provenance are signed.
Rollback to previous runtime/package is rehearsed.
Compromised-key and bad-release procedures are documented.

tasks.title: Publish GA artifacts and versioned documentation
tasks.objective: Release stable packages, binaries, source, QPack tools, docs, examples, benchmark evidence, and support/security contacts.
acceptance: Clean install and hello/reference app pass from public artifacts.
All URLs and package metadata are final.
Release notes list known limitations and compatibility.

tasks.title: Execute post-release monitoring and response plan
tasks.objective: Closely monitor first production users and define patch/release cadence.
acceptance: 24-hour and 7-day review checkpoints exist.
Issue triage severity and security response timelines are active.
Performance/regression telemetry is reviewed.

tasks.title: Approve production-ready GA
tasks.objective: Use “production ready” only after technical, owner, release, and operational gates are all satisfied.
acceptance: M8-001 through M8-005 are PASS.
No unresolved P0/P1.
Production-readiness reviewer and project owner approve the final packet.
Final source, Git history, artifacts, evidence, and checksums are archived.
